title: 💻 Multiple IT Openings in Washington County, VT - Hybrid & Entry-Level Roles - NewsBreak
text:
1 days ago Washington County’s tech scene is buzzing this month, with new openings for both seasoned IT pros and students looking to get hands-on experience. Here are a few worth checking out:
Business Analyst (UM) Employer: Norfolk & Dedham Insurance
Location: Montpelier, VT
Type: Full-time
This role bridges business and IT, helping teams improve processes and deliver better products. Great fit if you enjoy problem-solving, training others, and keeping projects on track.
Enterprise Data Architect Employer: Radiant Digital
Location: Hybrid – Montpelier, VT
Type: Contract (16 months)
A strong opportunity for experienced architects with TOGAF certification and cloud know-how. You’ll shape data systems and governance frameworks for large-scale modernization projects.
Judiciary Intern (IT Help Desk) Employer: State of Vermont
Location: Montpelier, VT
Type: Temporary, Full-time/Part-year
Pay: $20.99/hour
Perfect for college students with basic tech skills. You’ll support the Vermont Judiciary’s Technology Service Center, helping users solve software and hardware issues while learning about state IT systems.
If you’re ready to grow your tech career—or get your foot in the door—these local roles are a great place to start.
Please note: Job listings change quickly. Some positions listed here may have already been filled, and links may no longer be active. Contact the employer or visit the official website directly for the most up-to-date information.
